_readme: Everything monetization-related is a switch here. Flip enabled:true, fill in the IDs, push. No code changes needed.
name: Recipes By Ninjas

affiliate.disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

email._providers: beehiiv: paste your Beehiiv embed/subscribe form URL into action. netlify = Netlify Forms (no account). convertkit/resend also work with their form URL.
email.headline: Get one new Ninja recipe a week

ideas._note: Personalized 'tonight's idea' emails via Resend. Needs RESEND_API_KEY, a verified sending domain, and postalAddress filled in (required by anti-spam law). Sends only to accounts that opted in.

members._note: Mark a recipe members:true in its data file. Until a login provider is connected the gate is visual only.

ai._note: Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in Netlify env. Without it (or once a cap is hit) the assistant still answers from the recipe library, just without AI-written reasons. Lower globalDaily to cap spend.

accounts._note: Turns on automatically when SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are set in Netlify env.
